notes.notes:
VSync added
Day-night cycle added
Sleep added
Customer spawn times adjusted

Default walk speed set to “Jogging.”

Sprint (fast run) feature added.

Ctrl key now toggles Walk mode.

Fixed typo and positioning issue on the “Open for Business” sign.

Resolved bug that caused customers to keep carrying their burgers on a tray.

Fixed issue causing the player character to start running at high speed at game start.

Customer spawn time on higher prices increased.
Fixed a bug that prevented the use of the wheelbarrow in the garden.
Required EXP rates for level up have been reduced.

Buyable Wheelbarrow added.
Free tray added on start.

Wheelbarrow Improved
Farm Place watering Enhanced
Tray Mechanic Added
Introduced a tray placement and carrying feature to the gameplay flow.

New Features
Auto-Save on Exit
Automatically saves your progress whenever you quit the game.

Improvements
Cow Purchase Workflow
Streamlined the cow-buying process with faster load times, clearer UI prompts, and more reliable feedback.

Balance Adjustments
Seed & Crop Pricing
Rebalanced seed and product prices to optimize early-game costs and ensure a smoother revenue curve throughout the run.
